scope: Correct provenance metadata for already published source illustrations without modifying the chapter text or figure binaries.

review.root_causes: Canonical source-svg-copy was misnamed on two QLoRA and two Tülu figures; ACL citations did not dispatch to versioned arXiv figure validation for the Dolma and C4 SVGs. Sardana Figure 5 needs embedded-raster provenance, not lecture-page crop validation. The Google TPU snapshot lacked its second actual reader location.
review.evidence: Compared six SVGs byte-for-byte against the versioned arXiv HTML assets, checked license and figure anchors in upstream HTML. Extracted Sardana Figure 5 from page 6, PDF object 32 via pdfimages and compared PNG bytes. The Google TPU animations retain their SHA, frame counts, and page-level license; both actual references exist.
review.visual: On seven local routes, all ten affected embeds load at 375 and 1280 CSS px with alt text, retained aspect ratios and no page overflow. Dense plots still need the built-in viewer on narrow screens; verified horizontal panning in the three-panel Tülu plot at 2.5×.
review.verification: Full asset suite: 207 passed. Publication suite (four workers): 804 passed and 13 skipped. Root build: 2099 pages; 350 built-output checks and 94 site unit tests passed. Zero broken internal links; both subject indexes current; 891541464 bytes below the size limit. Historical registry restoration is byte-identical.
review.remaining: This verifies the affected figures and the current root artifact; it is not whole-book editorial completion or a deploy. No commits or remote writes.
